learning_outcomes.text: Analyze and design systems in the field of machinery and industrial construction.
Acquire knowledge in the theory and design of machines, theory and design of structures, and mechanical vibrations.
Express and communicate ideas related to the construction of machines, mechanisms, and industrial structures.
Master the usual calculations and tools in the field of machinery construction and industrial buildings.

syllabus_topics: Articulated node structures and rigid node structures
Global stiffness matrix. Assembly. Load vector.
Completion of exercises on the topics covered
assessment_rules: The final exam requires a minimum grade of 5/10 to pass. Students who fail the final exam may take a recovery exam covering all content, which also requires a minimum grade of 5/10 to pass the subject.
